deduplication.owner: RC-020 audio coordinator; one owner per presentation session
deduplication.reason: IDs are controller-local; Exact replay may reuse numerical IDs, so session identity is required
deduplication.cancel_policy: Invalidate pending milestones first; stop/fade only voices owned by invalidated generation with a bounded click-safe release; audio never applies gameplay or calls presentation completion

mix_policy.normal_contact: One actor variant plus positive player HP-loss impact; otherwise actor plus previously unrepresented full-block shield. Never actor + impact + block.
mix_policy.reduced_cast_group: At Cast phase start play cast; suppress separate enemy damage and shield-gain cues within this Cast group. At actual retaliation contact choose one player damage if applied>0, else shield if blocked>0, else actor variant. Lethal Cast has no retaliation.
mix_policy.reduced_priority: A later meaningful milestone replaces old foreground tail; no delayed queue. Cleanup and non-technique arrivals drop under an active higher-priority voice. Dedicated technique arrival and actual result remain meaningful.
mix_policy.reduced_file_duration: Unchanged WAV; do not resample/compress audio to the .06-second visual cap or add timeline delays
mix_policy.headroom_note: RC-020 rapid eight-voice edit stress initially reached +1.113 dBFS at Master. A deliberate -6 dB SFX bus trim is additional to unchanged per-cue gains and user volume; final measured repeat is in RC-020 verification.
